Capitol Hill rule changes inspired by #MeToo not expected as part of spending bill, aides say
https://t.co/gsTucPURBY

@Myqui @Ladybugs444 @nowthisnews With all due respect, that would only have served to make his statement appear true. But the #MeToo movement is about real, actual sexual abuse, & harassment. Not, to be used as a convenient weapon to win an argument, or win against enemies.

@Myqui @Ladybugs444 @nowthisnews I agree with you on that. I was commenting on the idea of staying put, then accusing him of sexual harassment. At that point you could accuse him of non-sexual harassment, intimidation, yes. I'm just saying misuse could water down real #metoo accusations.

@Myqui @Ladybugs444 @nowthisnews Ty. And btw, I'm sorry that you and your partner experienced assault in your lives. I hope the #metoo movement helped you feel heard.💚 Also that it makes such experiences a thing of the past (not the future) for women, kids, & men.

@Myqui @Ladybugs444 @nowthisnews Yet, at the very least the #metoo movement has given victims a voice that ppl are finally listening to. And many of the powerful men who've assulted & harrashed are now being punished. That's more than we've had happen in the past.
